description: This file implements debugging tools for a PDF.js viewer, including font inspection, page stepper, and statistics modules, with a PDFBug class managing their initialization and UI.

classes.name: Stepper
classes.description: Represents a page-specific operator list stepper for debugging PDF rendering.

methods.name: FontInspector.fontAdded
methods.description: Handles the addition of a font object, updating the UI with font info and controls.

methods.name: Stepper.updateOperatorList
methods.description: Updates the displayed list of operators for a page, with breakpoints and visualization.
